content.text:
I opened the PR: **https://github.com/cv/pi-action/pull/41**. The commitlint CI job still isn't on it, because the App token can't push workflow files: `refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml without workflows permission`.

**What's on the branch:** `main` had moved on (#40), so I rebased onto it and pushed. It has three commits:
- `feat: stop installing git hooks in the target repository`
- `docs: say that pi follows the repository's own commit conventions`
- `docs: add AGENTS.md that points agents to the commit conventions`

`npm run check` passes on the branch.

**The CI job:** I rebuilt the `ci: check the commits of each pull request with commitlint` commit on the rebased branch and put it in the PR description as a patch you can apply with `git am`. It needs one of these:
- give the pi-action-agent App the **Workflows: write** permission, and I'll push it next run; or
- apply the patch from the PR description yourself: `gh pr checkout feat/38-no-agent-hooks`, then `git am ci.patch && git push`.

With the patch applied:
- `npm run check` passes.
- This PR's commits pass commitlint with no problems and no warnings.
- Adding a `release: v0.35.1` commit makes it fail (exit 1, `type-enum`).

**Open question:** I went with a minor release (2.3.0), with the main commit as `feat:`; no inputs or outputs change. The PR includes proposed release-note text, since there's no CHANGELOG file and release notes live on GitHub Releases.
